_comment: Functional alternatives for models whose licences bar commercial use.
This file says only which models do the same job. It makes no licence claim:
each option's licence is read from licences.json at the moment it is offered,
and an option is offered only when that licence permits commercial use
(outright or with conditions). Quality notes are practical, not legal.
Match patterns are lowercase substrings of the weight filename, as in licences.json.
An option's 'exclude' patterns keep LoRAs and variants with the same stem from being taken for the model itself.

options.name: FLUX.1 [schnell]
options.note: Same architecture, distilled for 1-4 steps. Drop-in for most FLUX graphs; expect less fine detail than [dev].

options.name: Qwen-Image
options.note: A different model family; needs its own loader, text encoder and VAE, so the graph changes.

options.name: Qwen-Image-Edit
options.note: Instruction-based editing; a different model family, so the graph changes.

options.name: SDXL 1.0 base
options.note: The full SDXL base: same architecture, needs normal step counts (20-40) instead of 1-4.

options.name: GFPGAN
options.note: Same job in the same face-restore nodes; tends to smooth skin more than CodeFormer.

options.name: Real-ESRGAN
options.note: Loads in the same Upscale Model nodes; a softer result than UltraSharp on fine texture.

options.name: BiRefNet
options.note: High-resolution dichotomous segmentation; usually needs its own loader node.

options.name: Depth Anything V2 Small
options.note: Same model family and nodes at a smaller size; less detail at edges.

options.name: MiDaS / DPT
options.note: Older depth models with wide node support.

options.name: ZoeDepth
options.note: Metric depth; a different preprocessor node.
